seo.title: Swiss3Design · Multicolor 3D printing in Switzerland
seo.description: Customise a vase, a card or a coaster in 3D, then let the workshop print it in up to four colors, in Gland and Pully. Delivered across Switzerland.
seo.imageAlt: Swiss3Design: a vase printed layer by layer in three colors

hero.title: Every relief starts with a layer.
hero.lead: Objects designed in our workshop that you customise live: shape, pattern, up to four colors. You customise it, we print it, in Gland and Pully.
hero.label: Studio object · sample configuration · real-time render
hero.visual: "Lavaux" vase printed layer by layer: the print follows the palette and the pattern you pick.

map.title: One color per altitude.
map.intro: A 3D printer has nothing but altitudes to stack. At 0.2 mm per layer, this {height} vase is a relief of {layers} contour lines, and each color band plays the tint of a map.
map.figure: The same vase, split into bands: one per color, from the build plate to the summit.
map.bands: Color bands, from the summit to the build plate
map.purgeLine: {purge}: that is all the color costs, and we show it to you.
map.cta: Customise the bands in the Studio

summit.title: Your name, in relief. Literally.
summit.lead: The "Relief" coaster is a massif made of strata. Your name crowns its summit, with a fictional altitude computed from it.
summit.note: The text stays in your browser until you send it to the workshop.
summit.label: Peak label
summit.poster: "Relief" coaster: a massif made of strata, seen from above.

studio.title: You customise it. We print it.
studio.intro: Four original objects that you customise in 3D before sending them to us. The firm price is confirmed on quote, within 48 hours.

set.title: Customise
set.text: Shape, pattern, colors, text: the object is customised in 3D, and grams and duration follow every move.

send.title: Send
send.text: One click sends the piece and its configuration to the workshop.

check.title: The workshop checks
check.text: A person reads every text and checks the piece: a firm price comes back within 48 hours.

print.title: Printed and delivered
print.text: Printed in Gland or Pully, shipped by Swiss Post, free from {amount}.

shop.title: Selected objects, printed to order.
shop.intro: Models picked for their design, started to order in our workshops.
shop.empty: No object in the shop for now. Customise yours in the Studio or send us a file.

atelier.title: Printed in Gland and Pully. Delivered across Switzerland.
atelier.intro: Each piece is started, checked and packed in one of our two Vaud workshops, then shipped by Swiss Post.

file.title: Already have a file?
file.text: STL, 3MF, OBJ or STEP: send it, and the workshop replies within 48 hours with a quote.
